title: A Rust style skill records each decision the refactor made
body:
The refactor makes a set of design decisions about this codebase: when to use a trait and when an enum, where a type parameter is worth keeping, how configuration is spread over builder, open and query, which comments to write, and when to split a function. They are recorded only in this milestone and its issues. A later session writing Rust here has no single place to read them.

## Proposal

Draft a Rust style skill after each step, with one rule per decision and the commit that made it. Finish it after the polish step, when the code shows the final shape. The skill states the guiding principle from the milestone: performance first, then simple, readable code, with as little code as possible and several simple lines preferred to one confusing line.
